text: Every process is a chain of small pushes.
Four to one, twice. Sixteen times slower.
A chain runs at the pace of its slowest link.
Trace it back: more than half the time went to one link.
So change only that link. Swap one pair for equal gears.
Same chain. Same pushes. Six seconds sooner.
Don't hurry the fast links. Find the one that waits.
